title: Honesty calibration under cross-domain query
summary: Calibration metrics are statistically excellent on a pilot of n=2 (SR9 AUC = 1.0, Brier = 0.006 after isotonic calibration). However cross-domain consistency (SR9) fails the 0.80 honesty gate. The deployment gate fell back to Youden J = 0. System correctly declined to claim generalisation.
findings: SR9 AUC = 1.0 and overall AUC = 1.0 on 6-sample pilot — perfect discrimination
Brier score improved from 0.204 to 0.006 after isotonic PAV calibration
SR9 honesty gate (>= 0.80) not satisfied — cross-domain generalisation claim rejected
Deployment gate fell back to quantile-target strategy; Youden J = 0
